_doc:
Design OPTIONS for the user to pick (user 2026-11-09: the user picks every character design from an option sheet; nothing else is
drawn for these characters until the pick is relayed). Writes this demo's project/web_prompts.json option jobs (opt_<char>_<a|b|c>),
rendered with python3 tools/openai/images.py <demo> <jobs…> --quality medium (cheap: options only; the picked design is redrawn at
high quality as the base pose later). Same file in Demo46–50; the table for this folder is chosen by the folder name.
Run: python3 scripts/design_options.py

opt_bonchan_a.prompt:
Image 1 is the STYLE and CHARACTER reference (image 2: closer face reference).

Art style EXACTLY like image 1: cute Japanese 2D anime, pastel cel shading, soft clean lineart, big expressive eyes, chibi proportions (2–3 heads tall), friendly and adorable for children — NOT scary, no blood, no sharp teeth, rounded shapes, a clear silhouette that reads at small size. Night-festival / onsen storybook mood.

Bon-chan: a talking paper-lantern yokai (chochin-obake) the player carries by its handle — a NEW mascot: cheerful, brave, a little boastful; the candle inside glows WARM ORANGE (it is the warm light of the game).

Design A: a classic red-and-white paper lantern with one big friendly eye and a long playful tongue sticking out, tiny stubby arms, a black wooden handle on top.

Wide 16:9 character design sheet image, ONE character (or the named group) standing in the centre, full figure from head to toe inside the frame with margin, plain flat light-grey background (#d8d8d8), nothing else. No text, no letters, no captions, no logo, no watermark, no UI.
